result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (feature/binary-config-serve-20260930). Scope: follow-up queue/session identity, per-run result metadata, ordering after completed turns, queue caps. 1 HIGH, 1 LOW. HIGH (src/coordinator.ts:220 with :226-237,:799): send_worker_message to a worker paused with previous_state=recovery_required skips the cancelDispatches branch keyed on w.state, so the acknowledged run queues behind the worker's stale unresolved dispatch; when the token-idle watchdog quiesces that dead run, fail() cancels the acknowledged follow-up, so no error is returned and the message is lost, violating the invariant at :196-200. LOW (src/store.ts:300, src/mcp.ts:150): get_worker_result(worker_id) can serve an earlier run's success as latest for a failed current run, with no staleness marker. Session identity, result identity, completed-turn ordering and the 100-turn cap verified sound. Report: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md, findings.json.
result.details:
Target verified by detached clone at /tmp/opencode/rev10/t (git rev-parse HEAD = d428e0f73...); /workspace/repo left at baseline 5672ead, clean, unmodified.

FINDING 1 (HIGH) trigger: worker holds an unresolved dispatch while reaching recovery_required (coordinator.ts:429-432 VM stopped reconcile, or :573-578 ambiguous delivery - neither cancels dispatches) -> pause_worker (previous_state=recovery_required) -> send_worker_message -> resume_worker. queueMessage's stale-dispatch cleanup at :220 tests w.state, which is 'paused', so cancelDispatches is skipped; the branch at :226-237 rewrites previous_state to booting/ready and returns delivery:'queued'. step() at state ready (:475-484) picks store.dispatch(id), the oldest unresolved row (store.ts:236-240 ORDER BY rowid), so the new turn is never submitted and is later cancelled by fail() -> cancelDispatches (:799). Reproduced with the repo harness (probes/followup-order.test.ts): acknowledged delivery 'queued' yet dispatches = sent:<original>, pending:<new>; after resume, submissions after the acknowledged message = 0; final state failed ('No token progress for 1s; worker quiesced'); acknowledged dispatch state 'cancelled'. Control case A (same setup without pause) is correct. Guards do not help: the tearingDown/intent guard (:201-208) only covers in-flight teardown, and tests/lifecycle.test.ts:527-678 covers only cancel/destroy/failure races plus paused+completed (:286) - never paused+terminal-with-stale-dispatch (the only terminal previous_state that can hold a stale row, since 'failed' always cancels first). Fix: compute the effective state (paused ? previous_state : state) and run the existing session check + cancelDispatches before enqueueing; add a regression test.

FINDING 2 (LOW): Store.result() filters dispatches that already have a result and get_worker_result returns only {worker_id, result}, so after run 1 completes and run 2 dies without a structured result the tool returns run 1's status:'completed' while the worker is 'failed', with no state or latest run_id to compare. Reproduced (probes/stale-result.test.ts). Fix: include state and the latest dispatch run_id (or is_latest_run) when run_id is omitted.

VERIFIED SOUND: session id retained across follow-ups and turn correlation via unique per-dispatch message_id (:581-584); identify() forces server-assigned identity and the filesystem fallback rejects a mismatched run_id (:685-686); finish() re-arms 'ready' only when another dispatch is queued (store.ts:277-299); cap probe shows 99 follow-ups + spawn prompt = 100 unresolved then 'Worker message queue full' (docs/MCP-API.md:25); refused message for paused/previous_state=cancelled leaves no dispatch row (transaction rollback).

EXPERIMENTS: only in /tmp/opencode/rev10 (copy of the target with node_modules from official Bun 1.4.2, bun.lock unmodified, fake provider/agent doubles, no credentials); probe copies in /workspace/.swarmforge/logs. No smoke test, no real provider, no config changes.
